verdict.rationale: Salv documents resolving false positives: alert status can be updated via API, good-listing remembers matches the team has already cleared, and clearance rules auto-close alerts with each auto-closed alert kept on the record as an audit trail. Cases also carry a status, notes and an assignee. Nothing explicitly documents reopening a closed alert or overriding a prior decision, and the audit trail is only described for auto-closed alerts, not manual analyst resolutions or overrides. Missing for 10: documented reopen/override of a resolved alert, an audit record of manual decisions and overrides, independent or hands-on corroboration.
